- Products: Saturn AL-31, Chengdu J-10, Sukhoi S-54 family

- Organizations: People's Liberation Army Air Force

Facts:
- The Saturn AL-31 is a family of military turbofan engines.
- The Saturn AL-31 currently powers all Sukhoi Su-27 derivatives and the Chengdu J-10 multirole jet fighter developed by China.
- The Chengdu J-10, NATO reporting name Firebird, is a lightweight multirole fighter aircraft capable of all-weather operation.
- The Chengdu J-10 uses a delta wing and canard design with fly-by-wire flight controls.
- The Chengdu J-10 is produced in China by Chengdu Aircraft Corporation for the People's Liberation Army Air Force.
- All members of the Sukhoi S-54 family resemble the Sukhoi Su-27 or more closely the Sukhoi Su-33 in general form.
- The Sukhoi S-54 family is built around a single Saturn AL-31 engine instead of two and is scaled down to a smaller layout.
- Kingway Brewery Holdings Limited is a leading beer maker in China.
